prompt:

Exactly ONE palm-sized pastel lavender power bank matching product reference: thick rounded rectangular rigid smooth shell, glossy BLACK rounded rectangular level window at one end of the broad front face, original white level markings, one short matching lavender loop and original seam. Preserve shell/window/loop proportions and relative positions. Never add cables, extra loops, new ports, brand names or accessories. The loop is a strap, not a charging cable. Keep original front facing the camera; no rear or hidden-edge reconstruction.
The exact fictional adult woman from canonical reference: low dark ponytail, oval face, cream long-sleeve blouse. Same face, hair and clothing throughout, normal five-finger hands, relaxed closed lips; separate male voice-over later.
Bright pale-oak electronics review counter, warm-white wall and soft blurred neutral accessory shelves, no signs or readable packaging. Fixed diffuse studio key and fill at 5200K, no visible window, no moving sunlight, same bright lighting in all scenes.
Distinct medium-close portrait showing same face and upper torso, product on left palm slightly below shoulder level, free right hand beside blank shell. Entire palm-sized product and loop visible in central 65% of frame. Friendly closed-mouth smile.
No added text anywhere: no captions, subtitles, titles, cards, watermark, readable background signs or invented product lettering. Preserve only intrinsic product markings. No collage or graphic layout.
